name: State Channelizing Agency (SCA) Term Loan Scheme
description: Concessional term loan scheme for rural & semi-urban enterprises with project cost between ₹1.40 Lakh and ₹50.00 Lakh. SCA provides up to 90% (max ₹45 Lakh) at 8.0% p.a. concessional interest with 7-year tenure and 6-month moratorium.
nodalAgency: State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) & Apex Corporations (NBCFDC / NSFDC / NSKFDC / NMDFC)
targetAudience: Rural micro & small enterprises, village manufacturing units, agro-processors, transport operators
requiredDocuments: Machinery Pro-Forma Quotations (2-3 vendor quotes with GSTIN)
